fields.statement: At 3927f7838: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate passes, including subtest 'gate environment names the head and the merge-base', where a gate command echoing env:$RHIZA_GATE_HEAD:$RHIZA_GATE_BASE: prints the worktree's rev-parse HEAD and the git merge-base HEAD origin/main answer, and prints an empty base when merge-base fails (no origin/main). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden passes, and the golden ship.gate summary names RHIZA_GATE_HEAD and RHIZA_GATE_BASE. Diff read: shipLocalGate appends both variables to os.Environ(); the real Exec (cmd/rhiza execIn) returns stdout only, so a failed merge-base yields an empty RHIZA_GATE_BASE, not error text.
